meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续盯着一个 Pull Request:反复检查 CI、评论和 review 线程;发现真问题就修复并推送,直到 CI 通过且没有未解决评论才停止。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit 这个 PR”或“帮我盯着 review”,要求它持续检查一个 PR 的评论、CI 直到可合并时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR,直到它通过 CI 能合并。
say.note: 开始轮询检查 PR 状态与 CI。

say.text: 盯一下 #42 的 review 讨论,看到问题就修。
say.note: 会验证未解决线程并修复。

say.text: 持续检查这个 PR 的最新评论和 checks,别停。
say.note: Claude 会循环处理直到干净。

howto.what_en: Claude continuously watches a pull request: it re-checks CI status, comments, and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues and pushes updates, and stops only when checks pass and no actionable comments remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to babysit or monitor a pull request, e.g., 'babysit this PR' or 'keep checking reviews and CI until all issues are resolved'.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until CI passes and it can merge.
say_en.note: Starts polling PR status and CI.

say_en.text: Watch the review threads on #42 and fix any issues.
say_en.note: Verifies unresolved threads and fixes real ones.

say_en.text: Keep checking this PR's latest comments and checks.
